title: Explorer console
responsibility: Loads recorded repository revisions and supplies the selected explorer screen with navigation, entities and evidence.

inputs.name: HarnessConsole.base
inputs.description: Required URL prefix used for the data client, media and export addresses.

inputs.name: HarnessConsole.path
inputs.description: Required address within the base, including any query string. Determines the selected branch, revision and screen.

inputs.name: HarnessConsole.navigate
inputs.description: Required host callback receiving the next relative address and whether to replace browser history. Corrections replace history; user navigation normally adds an entry.

inputs.name: HarnessConsole.links
inputs.description: Compatibility input accepted by the prop type but not read or rendered by this component.

inputs.name: HarnessConsole.exportable
inputs.description: Optional export availability flag, defaulting to true. False supplies the screen with an empty export address.

inputs.name: HarnessConsole.content
inputs.description: Required screen component rendered once its selected revision and parent context are ready.

outputs.name: HarnessConsole
outputs.description: Explorer header and selected screen, with loading, unavailable-address, truncated-history and missing-registry notices. Index and selected-revision failures become visible problem text; unavailable parent data becomes null.
